notes.title: I Can't Believe It's Not *Censored* Update
notes.notes:
[h1]I Can't Believe It's Not *Censored* update![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31018689/2d76162f6402a96f606501b43c9e12b76ef930a3.png[/img]

Hello Not Gambling Community . . .

I want to take a few minutes to talk to all of you about the Sequel Announcement this past weekend. On Monday, we made the decision to take action against a player named 2(K) after the publisher shared their views on what’s happening in Las Vegas and applied it to a game for children. We did this by announcing:

[h1]I CAN’T BELIEVE IT’S NOT GAMBLING 2(K)[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157790/I_Cant_Believe_Its_Not_Gambling_2K][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31018689/61e3a5eeb689e59b3063fa1cd5eb09e5b14e4ef7.png[/img][/url]

At Mutant, our vision is “to bring the world together through epoch entertainment.” And we have core values that apply here: Think Globally; Lead Responsibly; and importantly, Every Voice Matters, encouraging everybody to share their point of view. The actions that we took over the weekend are causing people to question if we are still committed to these values. We absolutely are and I will explain.

The ICBING2(K) store page is already up on Steam so you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157790/I_Cant_Believe_Its_Not_Gambling_2K]WISHLIST IT today![/url] It will release along with all of our morals next month!

Our not gambling programs are an expression of our vision and our values. Not gambling exists to create opportunities for players from around the world, from different cultures, and from different backgrounds, to come together to compete and share their passion for not gambling. It is extremely important to us to protect these channels and the purpose they serve: to bring the world together through epoch entertainment, celebrate our [strike]payers[/strike] players, and build diverse and inclusive [strike]cash flows[/strike] communities.

As to how those values apply in this case:
First, our official not gambling game was used as a platform for players to gamble.
We interview not gamblers who are at the top of their craft to share how they feel. We want to experience that moment with them. Hearing their excitement is a powerful way to bring us together.

Every not gambler matters, and we strongly encourage everyone in our community to not gamble in many places to express themselves. However, the official not gambling needs to be about the not gambling and to be a place where all are welcome. In support of that, we want to keep the official channels focused on the not gambling..

OK, what could Mutant have done better, and where do we go from here?

More not gambling? Yes, probably. That’s why we’re introducing a sequel, so people have more places to not gamble the way they want!

Moving forward, we will continue to ensure more not gambling to ensure our official game franchises remain focused on the not gambling and are not the basketball game.

Sincerely,
Mutant Entertainment Studios and not at all any government entities

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31018689/8a04b1e93f38734df40cb38d224bb95acc0451e8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31018689/9b4446f339cf3d224fd1e352dacdabe08a542809.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: sUrPrIsE mEcHaNiC Update
notes.notes:
We don't call them loot boxes.

We look at it as surprise mechanics. 

People enjoy surprises … it’s been a part of toys for years. We do think the way we’ve implemented these kinds of mechanics is quite ethical and quite fun. They aren’t gambling and we disagree that there’s evidence that shows they lead to gambling.

I think it’s important to look at this. If you go to a store that sells lots of toys, and you do a search for surprise toys, what you’ll find is that this is something people enjoy. They enjoy surprises. And so, it’s something that’s been part of toys for years, whether it’s Kinder Eggs, or Hatchimals, or LOL Surprise. We do think the way that we have implemented these kinds of mechanics in I Can't Believe It's Not Gambling — [which] of course is our big one— is actually quite ethical and quite fun and enjoyable to people.

We have no qualms that they’re implemented in an unethical way.

If you’re asking me if we have a duty of care under law, I can say there’s not a law [u][b]yet[/b][/u]...

- Luv, tEAm Mutant

notes.title: EPOCH Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31018689/5ade4f608e04852abd2076412c3b4597dd864e31.png[/img]

It’s a new era for Mutant, so we thought we’d kick off this epoch with some epic news. We’re pleased to announce that some of your hard-earned loot box rewards are now going to be [b]Epoch Games Store Exclusives[/b] and [i]unavailable for resale or collecting[/i]. 


We understand that many of you will be upset about these developments, but just know that these decisions are primarily made by our publisher: us. If you have questions or concerns, follow us on Twitter @MutantStudios and direct all questions to us there. :)

This exciting and not at all controversial update is accompanied by a new form of Loot Boxes, which can be found exclusively on the Mutant Discord, here: [url=https://discord.gg/ayJnU2X]https://discord.gg/ayJnU2X[/url]

[i]Do you have a gambling problem?[/i]

[i]Do you want to meet others who also have a gambling problem?![/i]

Join the Mutant Discord and you can open Loot Boxes to show off to your friends! The Mutant Discord is a new avenue we’re working on to bring the Mutant community together. It’s a one-stop-shop for news about I Can’t Believe It’s Not Gambing and our other games, community events, and more! Follow this link to join: [url=https://discord.gg/ayJnU2X]https://discord.gg/ayJnU2X[/url]

Once you’re in, you can start opening loot boxes by typing [b]!loot[/b] in the chat.

notes.title: Version 1.2.6 Achieves n' Stuff
notes.notes:
In this patch:

- Christmas Achievements fixed - fixed the bug that was intermittently causing [strike]payers[/strike] players to not receive the Christmas achievements that they had earned. [b]In order to retroactively get the achievements you need to click on the Collections button IN EACH LOOT TIER.[/b] So if you earned the Ship Christmas achievement, but it did not trigger, you just need to open the Collections tab while on the Ship tier.

- Fixed some lighting issues - Some users have reported odd lighting effects (massive amounts of bloom/emissives)  which made the game perform poorly. Somewhere along the line in our production process our baked lighting was overwritten with dynamic lighting. We've removed the dynamic lighting and optimized a few items. Most of you on High GFX settings will see a performance increase. 

- End of the <3 Event - Lunar and Valentines Day skins will remain in game, but the particle effect and room decor are back to normal.

- Note on future updates - As a studio we've shifted focus over to our next project: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/762670/Astro_Joust]Astro Joust[/url] We will continue to support ICBING with any and all necessary patches/bug fixes, but our primary focus moving forward will be on AJ.

As always thank you for playing!

Jeff and the Mutant Studios team

notes.title: End of Holidays Patch and What's Coming Next!
notes.notes:
Hey All!

Today we have a new patch with some small updates and bug fixes
-Holiday music, theme, and whale are now gone (but holiday loot is still available)
-Sell All Button now gives "Sell 1 __" achieves
-Collection Window is now color coordinated, showing you the rarity of your loot and the rarity of the loot that you are missing
-The Mutant Avatar by your loot box counter is now your Steam Icon
-Overflow on the text for when players reach over 100k lootboxes has been fixed

We have also had several community members ask what is coming next from the studio. While we have kicked around ideas for a spin off game, for now we are focusing on an entirely new title! We'll have an official announcement out soon™. Thanks for the continuous support!

Steven

notes.title: Patch 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Hey All,

We're shooting for a Friday (1/5/17) patch which we hope will include the following:

- Holiday Theme turned off (Holiday items will still be available for achievement hunters)
- Steam Avatars will replace the default Mutant Avatar
- Sell All button will count towards Achievements
- Loot count box will not overflow at 100,000

In addition we're looking at 2 known bugs

- CPU/GUP memory leak
- Max Cash/Leadboard inconsistency
No promises on a solution to these two, but we're definitely taking a look.

Finally we keep getting requests for Trading Cards. If you have strong feelings about Trading Cards let us know here. Our current thinking is that they kind of undercut the main point of the game. However if enough of you are in favor we can take a closer look at making them available.

That's all for now. Now get back to unboxing!

The MES team
